description: Athena Workgroup Does Not Enforce KMS-Backed Query Results
rationale: The enabled workgroup does not enforce KMS encryption for query results. Athena/S3 may still use SSE-S3 and is not necessarily unencrypted. This is a customer KMS policy review.
remediation: If required, configure SSE-KMS or CSE-KMS output settings and enable workgroup configuration enforcement; separately validate bucket encryption.
